criteria.requirement: Implement feedgen.ordering.sorted_feed(feed,*,by="updated",reverse=True,missing="last",since=None,limit=None) and reusable copy_feed(feed,entries). Compare actual updated/published instants across offsets, retain original order on ties, explicitly place or reject missing dates independent of reverse. Inclusive aware since excludes undated entries, nonnegative limit supports zero. Return deeply independent FeedGenerator preserving metadata/extensions/entry content; never reorder or mutate original feed. Reject naive boundaries and invalid modes before changing anything.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
